mctd.help.1: Enemies walk along the path. Each one reaching the castle costs lives.
mctd.help.2: Build towers with the wand: right-click grass next to the path.
mctd.help.3: You earn gold for defeated enemies, cleared waves and interest.
mctd.help.4: Element essences (start + every four waves) raise an element's level.
mctd.help.5: Element towers need their element, dual and triple towers several.
mctd.help.6: Every wave has an element: strong = double, weak = half damage.
mctd.help.7: Enemy kinds: normal, fast, mass, air (not every tower hits them), boss.
mctd.help.8: Abilities: immune, regeneration, healer, undead, splitting, armored.
mctd.help.9: Every 10 waves a boss appears, in wave 50 the final boss.
mctd.help.commands: Commands: /td lobby · /td menu · /td next · /td info · /td leave · /td return · /td quit · /td stop
mctd.help.title: ═══ MC Tower Defense ═══
mctd.layout.spiral.desc: The longest route: a spiral into the centre.
mctd.layout.zigzag.desc: Short route with far-apart lanes – hard!
mctd.menu.build.hint: Tip: sneak + right-click builds the last tower again
mctd.menu.elements.info.1: Each essence raises an element by one level.
mctd.menu.elements.info.2: Level N unlocks tier N of element towers.
mctd.menu.elements.info.3: You get essences at the start and every four waves.
mctd.menu.lobby.info.1: Pick a map (row) and a difficulty.
mctd.menu.lobby.info.2: Build towers, collect essences, choose elements.
mctd.menu.lobby.info.3: Survive 50 waves – including the final boss!
mctd.menu.main.endless.info: Keep playing with ever stronger waves
mctd.menu.main.help.info: Explains elements, towers and enemies in chat
mctd.menu.main.leave.info: Back to your world. The game pauses.
mctd.menu.main.next.running: Enemies are still walking – waves will overlap!
mctd.menu.main.restart.info: Same map and difficulty, fresh arena
mctd.menu.main.stop.info: Ends the game for everyone and removes the arena
mctd.msg.already_in_game: You are already in a game. Leave it with /td quit.
mctd.msg.defeat: DEFEAT in wave %s · %s enemies defeated · %s leaked · %s gold earned.
mctd.msg.endless: Endless mode! How long can you hold out?
mctd.msg.essence: ✦ New element essence! (%s available) Open the element menu with the wand.
mctd.msg.left: You left the arena. Without players the game is paused. Come back with /td return.
mctd.msg.no_dimension: The arena dimension is missing. Is the mod installed correctly?
mctd.msg.not_in_game: You are not in a tower defense game.
mctd.msg.only_owner: Only the game's owner can end it.
mctd.msg.peaceful: Tower defense needs monsters – the difficulty was set to Easy.
mctd.msg.rejoin: Welcome back! Your tower defense game is waiting (wand → menu).
mctd.msg.target_not_in_game: That player is not in a game.
mctd.msg.tutorial: Wand: right-click grass = build a tower, a tower = upgrade/sell, the air = menu. Sneak + right-click builds the last tower again. Double jump = fly.
mctd.msg.victory: VICTORY! %s waves survived · %s enemies defeated · %s leaked · %s gold earned.
mctd.msg.welcome.start.hover: Opens the lobby: choose map and difficulty
mctd.result.element_maxed: This element is already at level 3.
mctd.result.still_spawning: The current wave is still spawning.
mctd.target.closest.desc: Attacks the enemy closest to the tower.
mctd.target.first.desc: Attacks the enemy that got furthest.
mctd.target.last.desc: Attacks the enemy that is furthest behind.
mctd.target.strongest.desc: Attacks the enemy with the most health.
mctd.target.weakest.desc: Attacks the enemy with the least health.
mctd.tower.abyss.desc: Hurls groups far back along the path.
mctd.tower.arrow.desc: Fast all-rounder, hits ground and air.
mctd.tower.blight.desc: A burning plague that spreads like wildfire.
mctd.tower.crystal.desc: Precise shots with a high critical chance.
mctd.tower.earth.desc: Boulders with large splash damage, sometimes stun.
mctd.tower.eclipse.desc: Massive single hits with the strongest of its three elements.
mctd.tower.fire.desc: Fireballs with splash damage set enemies on fire.
mctd.tower.forge.desc: Support: increases the damage of nearby towers.
mctd.tower.geyser.desc: Hot fountains: splash damage, knockback and slow.
mctd.tower.gold.desc: More bounty for enemies in range and gold per wave.
mctd.tower.hellfire.desc: A beam that keeps getting hotter – ideal against bosses.
mctd.tower.lava_flow.desc: Viscous lava: huge splash damage, burning and slow.
mctd.tower.light.desc: Beams of light jump to further enemies.
mctd.tower.lightning.desc: Chain lightning jumps between many enemies.
mctd.tower.magma.desc: Lava bombs with huge splash damage and burning.
mctd.tower.meteor.desc: Meteors with huge splash damage that stun.
mctd.tower.mist.desc: Toxic mist curses and slows everyone in range.
mctd.tower.moon.desc: Moonlight curses and slows whole groups.
mctd.tower.mud.desc: Mud slows every ground enemy in range.
mctd.tower.nature.desc: Poison thorns hit several enemies at once.
mctd.tower.necropolis.desc: Five targets at once; weakened enemies die instantly.
mctd.tower.obelisk.desc: Boosts damage and speed of nearby towers and attacks as well.
mctd.tower.plague.desc: A plague that spreads to nearby enemies.
mctd.tower.prism.desc: Refracted light jumps through entire waves.
mctd.tower.quake.desc: Earthquakes hit all ground enemies and stun them.
mctd.tower.rainbow.desc: Several beams, each in the strongest element.
mctd.tower.soultree.desc: Hits four targets and instantly reaps weakened souls.
mctd.tower.spring.desc: Support: increases the attack speed of nearby towers.
mctd.tower.steam.desc: Hot steam hits every enemy in range.
mctd.tower.sun_altar.desc: Solar flares burn every enemy in range.
mctd.tower.sunspear.desc: Huge range, more damage at a distance.
mctd.tower.swamp.desc: Stacking poison and slow for everyone in range.
mctd.tower.tidal.desc: Tidal waves push enemies back along the path.
mctd.tower.treasury.desc: Much more bounty and lots of gold per wave.
mctd.tower.twilight.desc: Uses light or darkness, whichever is stronger. Bonus damage by max health.
mctd.tower.volcano.desc: Eruptions hit all ground enemies and set them on fire.
